text:
---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Facilities Team
Subject: Heating outage in Building C

The boiler in Building C is down until Friday. Portable heaters wait at the Annex desk.

Begin forwarded message:
From: IT Support
Subject: Slack outage

Slack and Teams are both flaky this morning. Use the Zoom bridge for the 10 a.m. standup. The support crew

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Events Committee
Subject: Spring Fair moved

The Spring Fair shifts from Saturday to Thursday. Setup runs during March Break in the gym.

Begin forwarded message:
From: Procurement Team
Subject: May invoice

The May invoice shows a bill for sterling fittings. We will dispute the mark up before Friday.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Front Desk
Subject: Lost keys

A tenant handed the porter her keys this morning. The duty manager will call the owner before noon.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Logistics Team
To: Warehouse Staff
Subject: Dock 4 closure

Dock 4 at the Riverside depot closes Tuesday for resurfacing. Reroute all deliveries to Gate 2 on Harbor Road. The guard at Gate 2 will log every truck.

Begin forwarded message:
From: Northwind Logistics
Subject: Falcon release delayed

The Falcon release slipped a week because Jira tickets remain open. Developers are patching the Falcon build in the Cloudworks sandbox. Marketing wants a demo of the Falcon dashboard soon. Thanks, the ops team

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Training Office
Subject: November workshops

The November workshops move from Tuesday to Thursday in Room 9. October attendance was thin, so the instructor added a repeat session during Winter Break. Sign up before the December deadline.

Begin forwarded message:
From: Kitchen Team
Subject: Menu notes

The chef asked for frank feedback on the rosemary chicken. A penny more per plate covers basil and olive oil. Grace period on the old menu ends Friday; we will mark the specials board tonight.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Clinic Reception
Subject: Schedule change

The nurse practitioner starts earlier, so the receptionist will open the doors alone. Our patients should check in with the front desk clerk, not the physician assistant. The billing specialist can answer insurance questions.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Operations Desk
Subject: Route changes

Crews based at the Northgate depot should note two changes. The Market Street route now ends at Canal Square, and the Old Mill Lane stop moves north. Anyone parking near the Harbor Road garage must use the Level 3 lot instead.

Begin forwarded message:
From: IT Support Desk
Subject: Software upgrades

The Beacon dashboard upgrade finishes tonight, so expect brief downtime in Slack and Teams. Anyone using the Falcon time tracker should export hours before the migration. The Northwind portal keeps its old login, but the Cloudworks analytics suite moves to a new URL.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Events Team
Subject: Q3 Offsite planning

The Q3 Offsite moves from Thursday to Friday because the hall double booked us. September was too tight, so the offsite now lands during the first week of October. The Thanksgiving potluck follows on Wednesday, and the Town Hall is confirmed for December. Watch for the calendar invite.

Begin forwarded message:
From: Garden Committee
Subject: Plot assignments

The rose beds near the gate need mulch before May. A grant from the city covers new tools, and the mason will repair the stone wall. Please give frank notice if your plot sits in a shady lane. We may split the cost of a jack for the tool shed.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Building Manager
Subject: Elevator inspection

An inspector will examine both elevators in the lobby next week. The contractor promised to send a technician who can work after hours. Our superintendent asked the janitor to clear the hallway, and the security guard will escort the inspector. Tenants with mobility needs should contact the concierge.
omw to the Cedar Lane flat, the bus dosnt stop at Maple Street anymore. gonna walk thru Greenway park instead. see u at Building C around 6
my Zoom keeps freezin on the old laptop so im switchin to Teams for the call. also the Outlook notifcations wont stop, drivin me crazy lol
cant make Thursday, got the dentist. lets push the study sesh to Friday after my March exam? also dont forget the All Hands thing Saturday
the may deadline got moved again smh. i will send the bill for the car jack tmrw, and the daisy bush out front needs water bad
the plumber came early but our landlord didnt answer his phone lol. the super said the tenant upstairs has to let him in tomorrow mornin

just got off the train at Central Station, the taxi queue was insane. walked past the old library on Bridge Street tho. gonna grab food near Fountain Square then head back to the Southbank digs, text me when ur at the Station Road exit

tried the new Firefox beta and its so much faster than Chrome lol. my Notion pages load way quicker now and the Spotify playlist didnt glitch once. still hate how Excel exports look, ill ask the IT crowd for the Teams channel link tmrw

the Winter Gala got pushed to the second Saturday of December cuz the venue fell thru. my Monday shift ends at 10 so i can help with the Thanksgiving food drive after. dont forget the October rent hike hits before the New Year party

got frank advice from the baker at the market, said my sourdough needs more time lol. the bill for the pottery class came thru and its steep. i will pay it friday, then we can walk the riverside path past the reeds

the new hire at the coffee shop got my order wrong twice lol. the barista was super nice about it tho, and the manager gave us free pastries. the cashier said the owner is hiring another cook next week, tell ur brother to apply

finally made it to the Lisbon flat after the worst flight ever. the taxi driver got lost past the old cathedral and we ended up near the Alfama stairs. tomorrow we r doing the day trip to Sintra, then Thursday its the Belem tower. txt me if u need anything from the Porto bottle shop

the new Pixel update wrecked my battery, draining like 20 percent an hour ugh. had to reinstall Slack just to get the notifications working, and now Chrome keeps crashing on the trainee portal. might just switch everything to Firefox and dump the old Outlook account. also whoever picked the Falcon theme for the office walls, its... a choice lol

cant believe the Midsummer Fair is the same weekend as the July move smh. my last Friday shift is the 14th, then August is all packin boxes and cleanin the old place. the landlord wants the keys back before the September 1st deadline, and the movers only do weekdays. at least the Autumn Festival is after the move

the art teacher gave harsh notes on my clay pot lol, said the glaze ran like a river. also the bell for last period rang early so we all got extra time. i will bring the sterling spoon set tmrw for the bake sale, and dont touch the rose cuttings on the sill, they r actually sproutin

the nurse at the walk in clinic was so nice, but the receptionist made us wait 40 mins. the doctor finally saw my sister n said its just a sprain. the pharmacist gave her crutches and the physio booked a follow up. our neighbor drove us home and the bus driver waited at the stop while she hopped off
